all.title: Safari Packages
all.subtitle: Wildlife, Culture, Adventure & Luxury
all.description: From the vast savannas to the hidden gems of East Africa, our safari packages are designed to give you unforgettable experiences in the heart of nature.

gorilla.title: Gorilla Trekking Safaris
gorilla.subtitle: Face-to-Face with Mountain Gorillas in the Mist
gorilla.description: Embark on an unforgettable trek into the ancient bamboo forests of Volcanoes and Bwindi. Stand feet away from endangered mountain gorillas in their wild sanctuary.

wildlife.title: Classic Wildlife Safaris
wildlife.subtitle: Witness the Great Migration & Iconic Predators
wildlife.description: Traverse the iconic Serengeti, Maasai Mara, and Ngorongoro Crater. Experience private game drives, river crossings, and pristine wilderness.

luxury.title: Luxury Safari Escapes
luxury.subtitle: World-Class Lodges & Bespoke Wilderness Luxury
luxury.description: Indulge in private heated plunge pools, dedicated butler service, helicopter transfers, and fine dining under stars at East Africa's finest luxury lodges.

cultural.title: Cultural Experiences
cultural.subtitle: Connect with Vibrant Traditions & Local Communities
cultural.description: Immerse in royal Intore warrior drum dances, craft workshops, coffee masterclasses, and meaningful cultural exchanges with East African communities.

group.title: Small Group vs Tailor-Made
group.subtitle: Your Journey, Designed Exactly Your Way
group.description: Choose between friendly small group departures with pre-scheduled dates or a 100% custom-crafted private safari with your own vehicle and guide.

About.heroAlt: East Africa volcanic landscape with mist
About.subtitle: Creating extraordinary, luxury safaris while protecting the wild spaces we call home.
About.foundersAlt: SHEMA Alain and ISHIMWE Yassel by the Acacia Safaris cruiser
About.story1: Founded by SHEMA Alain and ISHIMWE Yassel, ACACIA SAFARIS began with a shared vision to connect travelers with the raw, untouched beauty of East Africa.
About.story2: As native Rwandans, we built our company on intimate, firsthand knowledge, ensuring every journey is lived, not just toured.
About.story3: Our office in Kigali and on-the-ground team manage every logistical detail in-house, offering unparalleled local expertise and access.
About.foundersText: With a deep love for East Africa and a strong background in tourism, conservation, and community development, SHEMA Alain and ISHIMWE Yassel lead ACACIA SAFARIS with passion, integrity, and a long-term vision for a sustainable future.
About.quoteShema: Tourism is more than travel — it's a powerful force for conservation, community, and lasting change.
About.quoteYassel: Our goal is to create meaningful experiences that benefit people, wildlife, and future generations.
About.whyTitle: More Than a Trip — It's a Deeper Connection.

About.journeyText: From expanding our Rwanda operations to developing seamless multi-destination experiences, our journey continues to be shaped by responsible tourism and meaningful travel.

expansion.title: Strategic Expansion
expansion.text: Acacia Safaris strengthened its East African footprint by expanding specialized travel experiences in Rwanda, with a strong focus on eco-tourism and primate tracking.

crossBorder.title: Cross-Border Experiences
crossBorder.text: New multi-day packages connected Uganda and Rwanda, creating seamless travel corridors for visitors combining gorilla trekking with regional wildlife experiences.

portfolio.title: Rwanda Portfolio Diversification
portfolio.text: Our Rwanda itineraries expanded across Volcanoes, Nyungwe and Akagera National Parks, offering gorilla and golden monkey trekking, chimpanzee experiences, canopy walks and Big Five safaris.

growth.title: Continued Growth & Impact
growth.text: Today, Acacia Safaris continues delivering tailored journeys across Rwanda and East Africa, with a growing focus on sustainable tourism, family holidays, birding and multi-destination adventures.

About.todayText: We continue to build authentic experiences that connect travelers with East Africa's wildlife, landscapes, communities and cultures while supporting a more sustainable future for the destinations we call home.

1.q: Do I need a visa for Rwanda?
1.a: Visitors from all countries can get a visa on arrival, or apply for an e-Visa online before travelling.

2.q: What is the best time to visit?
2.a: The dry seasons (June – September and December – February) are best for gorilla trekking and safaris, but Rwanda can be visited all year.

3.a: Yes. Treks are led by experienced rangers and guides who know the gorilla families and the mountains very well.

4.a: Absolutely. Every part of your journey, from lodges to activities and dietary needs, is tailored to you.
